items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I met him at Eddie Pearson's funeral

ctx.x: He told me about that. Yeah, he was in that band.

Did you play much with the D? Not regular, but now I'm dead, you know, somebody hiring them. Play with them. How about Happy Landings? Did you ever work there? Happy Landings? Yeah, I worked there with Joe G. Parker. He was playing in that for a good while with us. I don't know anything about him much, you know. Did he? No, Joe G. Parker. Oh. He must have been an awful good piano player. I just didn't know him. He was playing in that for a good time. He was playing in that for a good time. I wish somebody had…
Did you ever play with Ernie Cagnall Alley? Yeah.
